turns.userText:
Extend the provided collective codebase into a reservation and schedule compiler.
Work in /workspace using the offline Python 3.11.14 environment.
Read /workspace/PROTOCOL.md for the complete version

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && echo '--- PROTOCOL ---' && cat PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && echo '--- instruction ---' && cat instruction.md && echo '--- SOURCES ---' && cat SOURCES.md && echo '--- submission ---' && find submission -m

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort && python3 --version && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -nE '^def |^class |branch|flow|runtime|route|tree' submission/pipeline_allgather.py | head -200 && sed -n '200,520p' submission/pipeline_a

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/        for a,b in path\[1:-1\]: raise AssertionError((.long segment.,path))/        # check intermediate vertices/' tmp/testfull.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i 's/if 0 < R < D and outcap < R and (sink not in S):/if 0 < R and outcap < R and (sink not in S):/' tmp/compiler_proto.py && python3 - <<

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && du -sb submission && find submission -type f | wc -l

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -e 's/for n in list(range(2,15))+\+\[16,20,24,32\]:/for n in [13,14,16,20,24,32]:/' -e 's/for it in range(100 if n<20 else 20):/for it in r

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -m cProfile -s cumulative tmp/bench_genfast.py > /workspace/tmp/profile.txt 2>&1 || true; head -40 /workspace/tmp/profile.txt

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && head -5 tmp/genfast_d2.py && grep -n 'class GenFast' tmp/genfast_d2.py && tail -5 tmp/genfast_d2.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -n 'dinic' tmp/genfast_d2.py | head && grep -n 'val=' tmp/genfast_d2.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -I -B submission/main.py < tmp/trace1.jsonl | head -4 && python3 -I -B submission/main.py < tmp/trace2.jsonl | head -3 && python3 -I -B

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed 's/\[0,1\],\[1,1\],\[2,1\],\[3,1\]/[0,5],[1,5],[2,5],[3,5]/' tmp/trace_zero.jsonl > tmp/trace_zero2.jsonl && python3 -I -B submission/main.

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -I -B submission/main.py < tmp/trace2.jsonl > tmp/out2.jsonl && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la submission && python3 -m py_compile submission/main.py submission/service.py submission/compiler.py submission/fastgen.py submission/wir

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && grep -n "float\|epsilon\|round\|0\.\| / " submission/compiler.py submission/fastgen.py submission/service.py | head -100

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && cp tmp/fastgen_pri_max.py submission/fastgen.py && python3 -m py_compile submission/fastgen.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && time python3 -I -B submission/main.py < tmp/trace_star2.jsonl > tmp/out_star2b.jsonl && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && rm -rf submission/__pycache__ && find submission -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -I -B submission/main.py < examples/requests.jsonl > /workspace/tmp/answers.jsonl && cat /workspace/tmp/answers.jsonl && python3 -I -B

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && stat -c '%y %n' submission/main.py submission/service.py submission/compiler.py submission/fastgen.py tmp/answers.jsonl | cat && find submissio

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 -I -B submission/main.py < examples/requests.jsonl > /workspace/tmp/answers.jsonl && python3 -I -B public_check.py examples/requests.js
